problems.quote: the major axis is along the y‑axis

problems.correction: the major axis is along the x‑axis
problems.verifierReason: Original states major axis along y-axis for ellipse with a>b; correct is x-axis.

problems.verifierReason: NDA syllabus covers planes in detail (equations, angles, distances), not just basic understanding.

problems.quote: These formulas convert products of trigonometric functions into sums or differences.

problems.quote: These formulas convert sums or differences of trigonometric functions into products.

problems.verifierReason: Original misassigns lagging strand synthesis to Pol I; Pol III synthesizes both strands, Pol I processes fragments.
